def combine_transform(grid):
 border=grid[0][0]
 vs=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j]==border for row in grid)]
 hs=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==border for x in row)]
 bg=grid[1][1]
 out=[]
 for bi,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(hs,hs[1:])):
  tiles=[[row[c:d+1] for row in grid[a:b+1]] for c,d in zip(vs,vs[1:])]
  tile=[r[:] for r in tiles[0]]
  for i in range(1,len(tile)-1):
   for j in range(1,len(tile[0])-1):
    vals=[t[i][j] for t in tiles]
    active=[v!=bg for v in vals]
    keep=any(active) if bi%2==0 else all(active)
    tile[i][j]=vals[0] if keep else bg
    if keep and vals[0]==bg:tile[i][j]=next(v for v in vals if v!=bg)
  out+=tile if bi==0 else tile[1:]
 return out
